text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein lauds efforts by Military Industrialisation Commission to build civil industries in Iraq.
- Iraq and UNSCOM held talks to close banned weapons files.
- Information minister says Kuwaiti rulers are isolated in the Arab world.
- Britain and United States oppose release of Iraqi money to enable Iraqis to go on pilgrimage to Mecca this year.
- Deputy Prime Minister Aziz receives French parliamentary official.
- (The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Commentary urges Gulf states to normalise relations with Iraq.
- Article says Washington faces real crisis because of its uncompromising attitude towards Iraq.
- Article says United States creates problems in Arab Gulf to push its states to buy more of its weapons.
